name: elysium-mainnet-v2-factory
_rpc: Kinetiq's public mainnet RPC. Fine for the deploy; the keeper and site may need a heavier one (docs/MAINNET-V2.md).
_poolManager: Uniswap's official v4 PoolManager on Elysium (developers.uniswap.org/deployments?chain=Elysium).
owner: FILL IN: the owner wallet (a software wallet, its own seed). Owns the rules; tightening is instant, loosening waits 3 days in public.
treasury: FILL IN: the treasury wallet (its own seed): the launch fee and the hook's 20% trading share go here.
vaultVerifier: FILL IN: Gloam's verifier on mainnet (unused by v2; CloakConfig needs a non-zero address).
_launchFeeBps: 1.5% of a successful raise, taken at settlement. At most 300 (3%). DECIDE (docs/MAINNET-DECISIONS.md).
_launchFloors: Every launch names a minimum raise of at least 50 HYPE (under its minimum, it fails and every deposit comes back in full, like Uniswap's graduation threshold and PinkSale's soft cap) and puts at least 50% of its raise into its pool. Raising them later is instant; lowering waits 3 days in public. DECIDE.
_caps: Beta bid caps: 100 HYPE per bid, 10,000 HYPE per launch. DECIDE.
_hook: Pool fee in pips (1e6 = 100%): 0.3% base, 10% at listing falling to 0.3% over 5 minutes. 20% of all of it to the treasury (CloakConfig feeRecipient), 80% to the creator: PROTOCOL_SHARE_BPS in the hook (decided Nov 10). Fixed in the hook for good.
